en.account_intro: The app works only when you're signed in. Your chats, settings and API keys stay on your phone.
en.account_no_google: There's no Google account on this phone. Add one in the phone's Settings → Accounts and try again.
en.account_not_set_up: This sign-in isn't set up yet. Use another account or try again later.
en.account_other_provider: This e-mail is already signed up with another account (for example Google). Sign in with that one.
en.apps_ad_markers_help: Comma-separated; text outside the message list
en.apps_anonymous: Anonymous chat (every new chat = a new person)
en.apps_areas_help: Not required: without marked areas the chat (text field, send button, messages) is found automatically. Mark them on the panel if something is read wrong – on a foldable once per screen.
en.apps_contacts_empty: No one chosen yet – in this app Auto won't write to anyone.
en.apps_contacts_help: Applies to replies from notifications and to Auto on the panel. Names must match how the app shows them.
en.apps_contacts_none_known: No conversations from this app yet – add people by name.
en.apps_contacts_section: Who it may chat with automatically
en.apps_ended_words_help: Comma-separated; a system label outside the messages
en.apps_intro: Turn on the apps where it should reply to new messages by itself (needs “Notification access” and the main switch on the first screen). Messaging apps that show a “Reply” button in their notifications appear here automatically.
en.apps_new_chat_idle: New chat if they don't reply
en.apps_new_chats_desc: For anonymous chats while Auto is running on the panel. First mark the optional New chat area. For an opening message also turn on “Start the conversation myself”.
en.apps_ocr_always: Always read messages from the screen picture (OCR)
en.apps_ocr_always_desc: Turn on if Test reading shows wrong or missing messages for this app. Needs Android 11+ and “Read messages from the screen picture” in Timing, limits and behavior.
en.apps_only_contact: Replies only to %1$s (turned on with Auto on the panel).
en.apps_regions_not_set: Screen areas: not marked – the chat is found automatically
en.apps_reply_everyone: Reply to everyone in this app
en.apps_seen_forget_confirm: Forget what was learned about “seen” in %1$s?
en.apps_seen_learned: Learned automatically: seen ×%1$d, not seen ×%2$d. It keeps improving with every reply.
en.apps_seen_learning: Learning: after the next message it sends and the person's reply, it will know what “seen” looks like here.
en.apps_seen_not_marked: The “seen” spot isn't marked, so it looks for words like Seen, Read or Delivered under the last message. For icons (ticks, a profile picture) mark the spot on the panel (Mark areas → step 5) – the app then learns its look by itself.
en.apps_skip_ads: Skip ads once the button is enabled
en.apps_skip_ads_desc: Reads ad labels and enabled Close / Skip buttons. Recognises Google ads (AdMob: full-screen, rewarded, app-open, video) even when they have no readable label. Waits during countdowns, keeps the reward of rewarded ads and never taps the ad itself.
en.apps_sms_allow: Allow access to SMS and contacts
en.apps_sms_denied: If Android doesn't offer it: Settings → Apps → Messages AI → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, then try again (or allow SMS and Contacts under Permissions).
en.apps_sms_granted: ✓ Access allowed. The AI sees your earlier SMS messages with the person (RCS chat messages only from the screen and notifications).
en.apps_sms_history: Read the whole SMS history with the person
en.apps_sms_not_granted: Without access the AI only sees the last few messages from the notification. It needs access to SMS and contacts (to find the person's number).
en.channel_keep_alive_desc: Quiet notification that keeps Messages AI from being closed. You can hide it here.
en.design_models_empty: Start with an on-device model or connect your preferred AI provider.
en.design_models_intro: Choose the AI that writes your replies. Add a fallback for when your main model is unavailable.
en.design_owner_intro: Your words, your rhythm. Learn from messages you wrote and refine your writing profile.
en.design_people_empty: Conversations appear here as you use Messages AI in your messaging apps.
en.design_people_intro: Manage each person's memory, notes and reply preferences.
en.device_model_damaged: ⚠ %1$s (%2$s) is damaged or incomplete – probably an interrupted download. Download it again.
en.device_no_space: No storage available for the download.
en.device_note: The model must be in .litertlm (LiteRT-LM) format.
en.device_note_gemma_e2b: Best multilingual writing among small models. Needs a phone with at least 6 GB RAM.
en.device_note_gemma_e4b: For powerful phones (8+ GB RAM). Slower.
en.device_note_smol: Very small – only to check that on-device models work.
en.device_pick: Choose a .litertlm file from the phone
en.device_pick_invalid: ⚠ This isn't a valid .litertlm model (damaged, incomplete or a different format).
en.device_unsupported_cpu: On-device models don't run on this device's processor (they need a 64-bit ARM processor, which almost every phone since 2017 has). Use a cloud model – free ones: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter.
en.dl_background_note: You can leave this screen or close the app – the download keeps going in the background (you'll see a notification). If the internet drops, everything downloaded so far is kept and the download continues by itself when the connection is back – even after restarting the phone.
en.dl_cancel_confirm: Cancel downloading %1$s and delete the %2$s downloaded so far?
en.dl_err_corrupt: The downloaded file is damaged. Tap “Continue download” to download it again.
en.dl_err_not_found: The file isn't on the server (HTTP %1$d). Choose another model.
en.dl_err_space: Not enough storage – free up another %1$s, then tap “Continue download”.
en.dl_err_storage: Can't write to the phone's storage.
en.dl_notif_waiting_text: %1$s: %2$s of %3$s saved. The download continues automatically when you're back online.
en.dl_partial_label: ↻ %1$d%% already downloaded – continues where it stopped
en.dl_replace_confirm: %1$s isn't fully downloaded yet. Stop it, delete what's downloaded and download %2$s instead?
en.dl_resumed: The download continues where it stopped.
en.dl_waiting_network: %1$s: waiting for internet – the download continues by itself. Saved: %2$s
en.dl_waiting_wifi: %1$s: waiting for Wi-Fi – the download continues by itself. Saved: %2$s
en.error_action_not_enabled: The model asked for an intervention that isn't enabled in settings – reply not sent.
en.error_broken_reply: The model (%1$s) returned an unusable reply – not sent. Choose a more capable model.
en.error_claude_refused: Claude declined to write this reply.
en.error_forbidden_word: The reply contained the forbidden word “%1$s” – not sent.
en.error_invalid_action: Invalid intervention suggestion from the model – not sent.
en.error_model_damaged: The model file %1$s is damaged or incomplete (probably an interrupted download). Download the model again under AI models.
en.error_model_file: The model file isn't selected or doesn't exist.
en.error_nano_not_downloaded: Gemini Nano isn't downloaded yet – in the provider settings tap “Download / update Gemini Nano”.
en.error_no_provider: No AI provider set up – add one in “AI models”.
en.error_rate_limited: Too many requests (%1$s) – try again a bit later.
en.home_auto_desc: Draft replies in the apps you enable. Choose how they are sent below.
en.home_intro: Thoughtful replies. Your voice, your control.
en.intervention_bot_question: They ask if they're talking to a bot
en.intervention_call: They want a call or a meeting
en.intervention_money: They want money or a payment
en.intervention_personal_data: They want personal data or a code
en.intervention_photo: They want a photo or video of you
en.keep_alive_text_off: Automatic replies are off – Auto on the panel still works
en.learn_apps_desc: These apps don't share their messages – the app reads them from the screen: open the list of chats and tap “📚 Learn all chats” on the floating panel. It opens chat after chat, reads the history and goes back; it never writes anything. The next time it only reads what's new. Tap 📚 again to stop.
en.learn_daily_desc: Once a day in the background (when the battery isn't low): new SMS, your replies, your style; with AI also the picture of you and memories of up to 5 people.
en.learn_daily_desc_play: Once a day in the background (when the battery isn't low): your replies, your style; with AI also the picture of you and memories of up to 5 people.
en.learn_forget_confirm: Forget the learned replies, the picture of you and where the SMS import stopped? Chats and memories of people stay.
en.learn_intro: The app saves the messages of all your chats and learns from them: who the people are, how you write and how you replied to similar messages before. Everything stays on your phone; learning how you reply runs on the phone without AI. Messages the app has already read are never read again – it remembers where it stopped.
en.learn_never: Not learned from everything yet – tap the button below.
en.learn_pairs: Your replies learned: %1$d (how you answered which messages)
en.learn_past_replies: Show the AI how I replied to similar messages
en.learn_past_replies_desc: For each new message the phone finds up to 4 similar messages you've already answered (in any chat) and gives your answers to the AI as a guide to your wording – never their content.
en.learn_saved: Saved: %1$d messages with %2$d people (%3$d written by you)
en.learn_sms_desc: All SMS chats in which you wrote something too, with names from your contacts (not bank notices, codes or ads). After the first time only new SMS are read.
en.learn_sms_no_permission: Needs access to SMS and contacts.
en.learn_step_owner: AI: updating the picture of you …
en.learn_step_people: Finding the same people in different apps …
en.learn_step_replies: Learning how you reply (on the phone) …
en.learn_summary: %1$d of your messages in %2$d chats, %3$d replies learned, %4$d new SMS, %5$d people linked across apps, %6$d memories updated.
en.log_accessibility_off: The accessibility service is off – can't open the chat.
en.log_ad_back: Google ad without a recognisable close button – closed it with Back once it was allowed.
en.log_ad_closed: Skipped/closed an ad; continuing once back in the chat.
en.log_ad_reward_kept: Rewarded ad asked whether to give up the reward – continued watching instead.
en.log_app_disabled: A message arrived, but automatic replies for this app are off (Apps).
en.log_app_discovered: New messaging app found – turn it on in Apps if you want replies there.
en.log_auto_follows: Auto followed you into this app.
en.log_auto_only_for: Auto is on only for %1$s – not replying.
en.log_background_on: Auto also replies from notifications, when the app isn't open.
en.log_cannot_find_field: Couldn't find the text field, or it didn't take the text.
en.log_cannot_find_send: The reply was typed, but none of the buttons sent it (%1$d tried) – mark the Send button in “Mark areas”.
en.log_contact_not_in_list: Not among the people chosen for this app – not replying.
en.log_copy_details_help: Copies everything the app did recently (each step: reading the screen, typing, buttons, notifications, AI) with your settings – paste it into a chat with an AI to find what went wrong. For the screen of a chat use “📋 Copy log” on the floating panel while the chat is open.
en.log_followup_skip: A follow-up doesn't fit – waiting for them to reply.
en.log_google_ad: Google ad on screen – waiting for it to end.
en.log_group_skipped: Group chat – skipped (Apps → Skip group chats).
en.log_hidden_content: Android hid the notification content (sensitive content), so I won't reply to it.
en.log_hidden_mark_regions: To reply on screen in this app, mark the areas with the floating panel.
en.log_hidden_opening: Notification content is hidden – opening the chat to reply on screen.
en.log_hint_learned: “%1$s” is the input field's hint – ignored from now on.
en.log_include_content: Include names and message text (only for finding errors)
en.log_learn_all: Learned from %1$d chats on the screen (%2$d new messages).
en.log_learned_field: Learned which field is for typing in this app.
en.log_learned_send: Learned which button sends messages in this app.
en.log_long_reply: The reply is longer than about 150 words – it waits for your confirmation.
en.log_no_button_open_chat: The notification has no Reply button – opening the chat to reply on screen.
en.log_no_open_intent: The notification doesn't open the chat.
en.log_no_regions_screen: Couldn't find the chat on the screen – mark the areas for this app on the panel.
en.log_no_reply_button: The notification has no “Reply” button – in this app's settings choose “Open the chat and reply on screen”.
en.log_old_on_start: Last message is older (%1$s) – not replying to it when Auto turns on.
en.log_opened_unread: Opened the unread chat from the list
en.log_owner_learned: Learned more about you and how you write (from your own messages).
en.log_people_linked: Same person as “%1$s” in %2$s – one memory for both.
en.log_play_screen_tap: Not answered on the screen by itself (Google Play version): open the chat and tap Draft reply on the panel.
en.log_ready_loop: Reply not sent several times in a row: %1$s
en.log_reply_button_gone: The “Reply” button no longer works (the notification was removed).
en.log_report_hint: Replies written by AI are marked with ⚑. Tap one to report it if it's offensive or inappropriate. In People & chats you can also long-press a message the AI wrote.
en.log_same_message: Same message as before – not replying again (loop protection).
en.log_screen_locked: The screen is locked – can't reply on screen.
en.log_seen_learned: Learned what “seen” and “not seen” look like in %1$s.
en.log_sent_blind: Sent although the text field doesn't show the text – I'll type the same way in this app from now on.
en.log_too_soon: Too soon after the last reply – waiting.
en.log_vision_read: The AI read the messages from the screen picture (%1$d).
en.log_vision_send: The AI found the Send button on the screen – remembered for next time.
en.main_accessibility_desc: Floating panel, reading the open chat, typing and sending on screen.
en.main_battery_desc: So the phone doesn't put the app to sleep (Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei …)
en.main_battery_ok_info: Running in the background is allowed. On Samsung also check Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: Messages AI must not be among sleeping apps. On Xiaomi turn on Autostart.
en.main_battery_warning: The phone may put the app to sleep to save battery – then replies from notifications stop. Allow running in the background.
en.main_behavior_sub: Delays, quiet hours, limits, groups, memory, stepping in
en.main_bg_limited: Replies when the messaging app is closed: only while unlocked
en.main_bg_limited_go: This phone (Android Go) doesn't allow notification access, so I see new messages through Accessibility – while the phone is unlocked.
en.main_bg_limited_note: Notification access is off, so I see new messages through Accessibility – only while the phone is unlocked. Turn on Notification access to reply with a locked screen too.
en.main_bg_need_access: Turn on Accessibility and Notification access – without them I can't notice new messages.
en.main_bg_need_accessibility: Turn on Accessibility – on this phone it's how I notice new messages.
en.main_bg_need_app: No messaging app is turned on. Turn on Auto on the panel in a chat – or in Apps turn on “Automatically reply to new messages” (e.g. for Google Messages).
en.main_bg_need_switch: The main switch “Automatically reply to new messages” is off.
en.main_bg_off: Replies when the messaging app is closed: off
en.main_bg_on: Also replies when the messaging app is closed
en.main_checklist_done: All set! The guide (📖) explains the details.
en.main_enable_service_first: Turn on the service in Accessibility first.
en.main_export_message: Should the file include your API keys? Never share a file that contains keys.
en.main_guide_sub: Getting started, seen, languages, adding an AI model
en.main_intro: A floating assistant that reads your chats and replies in your style – following your rules.
en.main_languages_sub: App language, languages you speak, translator note
en.main_learning_sub: Learns from all your chats: SMS, chats on the screen, how you reply
en.main_learning_sub_play: Learns from your chats on the screen and how you reply
en.main_listener_desc: The app notices by itself when and from whom a new message arrived, and can reply right from the notification.
en.main_listener_unsupported_desc: This phone doesn't allow it (Android Go) – new messages are detected through Accessibility instead.
en.main_listener_unsupported_info: Phones with little memory (Android Go) don't give any app notification access. Messages AI notices new messages through Accessibility instead and replies with the notification's Reply button – this works while the phone is unlocked. With a locked screen Android hides the content of notifications.
en.main_log_sub: What the app received, sent or skipped
en.main_master_desc: Applies to the apps you turn on in “Apps”. On screen you turn Auto on with the panel button. There's also a quick toggle in Quick Settings (the “Messages AI” tile).
en.main_notifications_desc: For reply suggestions you approve with “Send”, and alerts when you need to step in.
en.main_owner_sub: Learned from your messages: who you are and how you write
en.main_people_sub: Each chat's history, memory about the person, per-person rules
en.main_persona_sub: About you, style, length, emoji, formal/informal
en.main_phone_sub: %1$s: what to set so the phone doesn't stop the app
en.main_quiet_now: 🌙 Quiet hours now (%1$s–%2$s): I'm not replying until they end.
en.main_restricted_settings: If the switch in Accessibility or Notification access is greyed out (“Restricted setting”): Settings → Apps → Messages AI → ⋮ (top right) → “Allow restricted settings”, then try again.
en.main_rules_sub: Forbidden topics and words, meetings, money, personal data …
en.main_send_auto: Automatic (each person once gets a short note that AI helps)
en.main_send_confirm: Quick confirmation – you send with one tap (notification with Send/Edit/Discard; on screen it only types)
en.main_service_stopped_note: Accessibility is on, but the service isn't running – the phone closed it. In Accessibility turn Messages AI off and on again, and in Phone & background set what %1$s phones need.
en.main_show_panel_desc: Mark areas, Test reading, Auto, Draft reply
en.main_terms_sub: Terms of use, privacy policy, liability
en.main_test_paused: Pause: %1$s (the test doesn't pause real chats).
en.main_test_skip: (the model thinks no reply is needed)
en.main_test_translator: (It mentioned the translator because you don't speak this language – see Languages.)
en.main_topics_sub: Topics to start or weave into the conversation
en.main_try_reply_sub: A sample chat in your language or a foreign one
en.main_vendor_tip: %1$s phones often close apps in the background. Open Phone & background once and set autostart / keep running so replies don't stop.
en.mode_log_only_desc: Only saves messages to the history and the log; doesn't reply.
en.mode_notification_desc: Replies with the notification's “Reply” button – without opening the app; works even when the screen is locked.
en.mode_screen: Open the chat and reply on screen
en.mode_screen_desc: Opens the chat from the notification and replies using the marked areas. The screen must be unlocked.
en.notif_intervention_body:
%1$s. Automation for this chat is paused.
%2$s
When you've handled it, tap Resume.
en.notif_listener_missing_text: Without it Messages AI only replies while the chat is open. Tap and turn on Messages AI.
en.notif_same_people_text: %1$d people may be the same person in different apps – tap to check in People.
en.notif_same_person_text: Is “%1$s” in %2$s the same person as “%3$s” in %4$s? If yes, the AI keeps one memory for them and sees both chats.
en.owner_based_on: From %1$d of your messages in %2$d chats (messages written by the AI don't count).
en.owner_examples_desc: The AI copies the style of these real messages of yours – never their content.
en.owner_forget_confirm: Forget everything learned about you? If learning is on, it will be learned again from your messages.
en.owner_intro: From the messages you wrote yourself in all chats (not the ones the AI wrote) the app learns who you are, how you write and how you talk to different people – so replies sound like you and always make sense. It stays on your phone and goes to your AI model with each reply, like the conversation itself.
en.owner_learn: Learn how I write from my chats
en.owner_learn_desc: Measures your style (length, small letters, punctuation, emoji, your spellings), picks real messages of yours as examples and, after every 60 of your new messages, asks the AI to update the description below.
en.owner_learn_failed: Couldn't learn – check the AI model, or there are too few of your own messages yet.
en.owner_learned: What the AI knows about you
en.owner_learned_field: About me (learned – you can correct it)
en.owner_learned_never: Not learned yet – tap “Learn now from my chats” (one AI call).
en.owner_learned_ok: Done – the AI now knows you better.
en.owner_learned_when: Updated %1$s from %2$d of your messages; it updates itself as you write more.
en.owner_review_desc: One more AI call per reply: does it make sense, is it clear, does it answer what they wrote, is it in your style? If not, it's fixed. Not with on-device AI.
en.owner_stat_words: Your most used words and spellings: %1$s
en.owner_too_few: Too few of your own messages so far (%1$d) – at least 15 are needed.
en.panel_hint: Open a chat and turn on Auto. Areas are found automatically – mark them only if something is read wrong.
en.people_clear_all_confirm: Delete all remembered chats and memories about people?
en.people_duplicate_desc: In %1$s: “%2$s” and “%3$s”. If it's the same person, merge them – the AI then has one history and one memory for them.
en.people_intro: Every chat has its own history and memory about the person. Tap a person for their rules (always/never reply, follow-ups), notes and topics.
en.people_linked_toast: Linked – one memory for this person in all apps.
en.people_reason_contains: One name is part of the other.
en.people_reason_first_name: Only the first name is the same.
en.people_same_apps_desc: People with exactly the same full name (or phone number) are linked automatically. For these I'm not sure – tell me:
en.people_search: Search by name, app or memory
en.person_always_allowed: Always (even if only selected people are allowed)
en.person_delete: Delete this person and everything about them
en.person_link_none: There are no people in other apps yet.
en.person_link_with: Link with the same person in another app …
en.person_linked_desc: One memory for this person in all these apps; when replying, the AI also sees the latest messages there.
en.person_memory_desc: What the AI remembers from your chats (interests, plans, events). You can edit it.
en.person_memory_failed: Couldn't update the memory (check the AI model).
en.person_merge_confirm: Merge “%1$s” into “%2$s”? Messages, memory and notes are combined and “%1$s” is removed.
en.person_merge_none: There are no other people in this app.
en.person_merge_pick: Which person should be merged into “%1$s”?
en.person_notes_help: Who they are, how you talk, what not to mention …
en.person_paused_desc: Open the chat and, if needed, send the photo or reply yourself. Then resume; the same request won't be handled again.
en.person_rename_desc: If the name was read wrong (for example from the screen picture), correct it here. If a person with that name already exists in this app, both are merged.
en.person_stats_style: Usually writes %1$s messages (about %2$d characters) · emoji in %3$d%% · questions in %4$d%%
en.person_stats_today: Replies sent today: %1$d · follow-ups since their last message: %2$d
en.person_translator_told: They've already been told you use a translator.
en.person_unlink_confirm: Unlink “%1$s” from the other apps? The memory stays here but isn't shared any more.
en.person_view_title: What the AI knows about them:
en.phone_battery_desc: Android doesn't put the app to sleep
en.phone_intro: %1$s. Many phones close apps in the background to save battery – then Messages AI stops noticing messages. Set the things below once.
en.phone_keep_alive_desc: Shows a quiet, permanent notification. Phones then hardly ever close the app. Usually not needed on this phone – turn it on if replies stop after a while.
en.phone_keep_alive_recommended: Recommended on this phone: a quiet, permanent notification keeps the app from being closed in the background. You can hide the notification in its settings (long-press it) – the app keeps running.
en.phone_on_device_yes: On-device AI models can run on this phone.
en.phone_screen_missing: This screen isn't on your phone – opening app info instead.
en.phone_steps_asus:
1. Mobile Manager → Auto-start manager: allow Messages AI (button below).
2. Settings → Battery → Power management: don't optimise Messages AI.
3. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_steps_generic:
1. Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery (App battery usage) → Unrestricted.
2. That's usually all this phone needs. If replies still stop after a while, turn on “Keep running” above.
en.phone_steps_huawei:
1. App launch: Settings → Battery → App launch → Messages AI: turn off “Manage automatically” and allow Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background (button below).
2. Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery: allow running in the background.
3. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_steps_lenovo:
1. Settings → Battery → Background apps (or Power manager): allow Messages AI (button below).
2. Battery optimisation: don't optimise Messages AI.
en.phone_steps_meizu:
1. Security → Permissions → Background management → Messages AI → Allow running in background (button below).
2. Battery: don't optimise Messages AI.
en.phone_steps_nokia:
1. Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Advanced → Battery → Battery optimisation → Don't optimise.
2. On older Nokia phones: turn off “Battery protection” / “Power saver” for Messages AI (button below).
en.phone_steps_oneplus:
1. Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery usage → Allow background activity (and Auto launch).
2. Settings → Battery → Battery optimisation → Messages AI → Don't optimise.
3. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_steps_oppo:
1. Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery usage: allow “Background activity” and “Auto launch”.
2. Settings → Battery → More settings → Optimise battery use → Messages AI → Don't optimise.
3. Autostart (button below, if your phone has it).
4. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_steps_samsung:
1. Battery: Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery → Unrestricted.
2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: Messages AI must not be in “Sleeping apps” or “Deep sleeping apps”; add it to “Never sleeping apps”.
3. Turn off “Put unused apps to sleep” or keep Messages AI out of it.
en.phone_steps_sony:
1. Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery → Unrestricted (or not optimised).
2. If STAMINA mode is on, add Messages AI to its exceptions.
en.phone_steps_transsion:
1. Phone Master → App management → Auto-start: Messages AI on (button below).
2. Settings → Battery → App power saving (or Background apps): Messages AI → don't restrict.
3. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_steps_vivo:
1. Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Messages AI → Allow.
2. Autostart: i Manager → App manager → Autostart → Messages AI on (button below).
3. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_steps_xiaomi:
1. Autostart: on (button below).
2. Battery saver: Settings → Apps → Messages AI → Battery saver → No restrictions.
3. Other permissions: allow “Display pop-up windows while running in the background” and “Show on lock screen” (needed to open chats).
4. In recent apps, lock the Messages AI card.
en.phone_tips:
• Lock Messages AI in recent apps (long-press or pull down its card → lock) so “Clear all” doesn't close it.
• Don't add it to cleaner or “boost” apps.
• If Accessibility shows “Not working”, turn Messages AI off and on again there.
• After an update or restart nothing needs to be set again.
en.pref_ai_vision: Let the AI look at the screen when reading fails
en.pref_ai_vision_summary: When an app hides messages from Accessibility and text recognition can't read them either, a picture of the chat is sent to your cloud AI (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini …) to read the messages, and to find the Send button when it can't be found otherwise. Not with on-device AI.
en.pref_always_on_summary: If the person says or it's obvious that they're under 18, the chat stays strictly friendly: no flirting, romance or arranging to meet.
en.pref_auto_all_apps_summary: Auto on the panel replies to everyone in every app turned on in Apps – from notifications, and on screen when you switch to that app
en.pref_bot_question: When someone sincerely asks if they're talking to a bot
en.pref_cat_seen: How it knows whether it's seen
en.pref_cat_step_in: When you need to step in
en.pref_contact_notes_help: One line per person, “Name: description”, e.g. “Anna: my sister, loves jokes”. Edit detailed notes for one person in “People & chats”.
en.pref_debounce: Wait for several messages in a row (s)
en.pref_followup_max_summary: Max follow-ups until they reply (at most 3, so it doesn't get annoying)
en.pref_followup_seen: If they HAVE seen it but don't reply, wait
en.pref_followup_style: What the follow-up should be like
en.pref_followup_style_help: E.g.: light, with a joke or a question, no pressure.
en.pref_followup_summary: When your message is the last one and they don't reply, it writes a follow-up
en.pref_followup_unseen: If they HAVEN'T seen it, wait
en.pref_forbidden_words_help: Comma-separated. If the reply contains one, it's rewritten; if it still does, it isn't sent.
en.pref_history_scrolls: Read the history the first time (screens up, 60 = whole chat)
en.pref_intervention_phrases: Extra requests that pause the chat
en.pref_intervention_phrases_help: One word or phrase per line, e.g. pick me up. Checked on the phone and by the AI, in any language.
en.pref_language_moved: The reply language and the translator note are in Languages (on the first screen).
en.pref_languages_info: The language is detected on the phone (no internet) from their latest messages, and the AI replies naturally in it. The translator is mentioned only once per person; you can reset that in People & chats.
en.pref_lock_contact: On-screen Auto only for the chosen person
en.pref_lock_contact_summary: Replies only to the person you turned Auto on for
en.pref_max_chars_summary: Max characters per reply (0 = no limit). A longer reply is rewritten or shortened.
en.pref_max_history: How many recent messages the AI sees
en.pref_max_per_contact_day: Max messages to one person per day
en.pref_memory_every: Update the memory every N new messages
en.pref_memory_summary: The AI notes important facts about the person (interests, plans, events)
en.pref_money_style_default: Default: politely declines money or payments, promises nothing and opens no payment links.
en.pref_money_style_help: Your own instructions. Empty = a polite refusal.
en.pref_no_personal_summary: Address, phone, surname, workplace, location, passwords, codes
en.pref_no_promises: Don't promise anything on my behalf
en.pref_ocr: Read messages from the screen picture when an app hides them
en.pref_ocr_summary: Some apps don't show message text to Accessibility. Then the messages are read from a picture of the chat (text recognition on the phone, Android 11+, Google Play services).
en.pref_opener_auto_summary: When the chat is empty (e.g. a new stranger in RandoChat), it writes the first message
en.pref_pause_call: Pause when asked for a call or meeting
en.pref_pause_personal: Pause when asked for data or codes
en.pref_pause_photo: Pause when they want a photo or video of you
en.pref_pause_photo_summary: Notifies you and pauses this chat so you can take and send the photo yourself. Then tap Resume.
en.pref_persona_help: Who you are, your age, what you do, what you're into and how you write. E.g.: I'm Mike, 30, an engineer. I write short and casual, no capital letters, and I like to joke around.
en.pref_quiet_summary: It doesn't write to anyone during this time
en.pref_reply_groups_summary: By default it avoids group chats
en.pref_return_summary: When it opens a chat from a notification and replies
en.pref_rules_allowed: What it may do and talk about
en.pref_rules_allowed_help: E.g.: It can joke, ask about the weekend, talk about sports and films, give compliments.
en.pref_rules_forbidden_help: One per line, e.g.: Don't talk about my job. Don't mention my ex.
en.pref_seen_info: On screen: on the panel tap “Mark areas” → step 5 “Seen / not seen” and circle the spot under your last message. The app learns by itself what “seen” and “not seen” look like there (it gets better with every reply). Without it, it looks for words like Seen, Read or Delivered (in many languages) under the last message; you can add extra words per app in “Apps”. When replying from notifications “seen” isn't known, so the “haven't seen it” wait applies.
en.pref_split_summary: Like a person: a few short messages in a row instead of one long one
en.pref_start_reply: When Auto turns on, reply to the last message
en.pref_topics_help: One topic per line, e.g.: hiking trip this weekend / the new Netflix series / concert on Saturday
en.pref_topics_info: Each topic is used only once per person (when all are used, it starts over). Add topics for a specific person in “People & chats”. Start a conversation with a topic using the “Start chat” button on the panel.
en.pref_translator_note: Tell them I use a translator
en.pref_translator_note_summary: If someone writes in a language you don't speak, the first reply mentions once, in their language, that you're using a translator.
en.provider_desc_claude: The best writing style and understanding of every language. Pay as you go.
en.provider_desc_deepseek: Very cheap paid models. ⚠ Chats are processed on servers in China (outside the EU, no adequate data protection under GDPR).
en.provider_desc_gemini: Free tier with a key from Google AI Studio (with per-minute/day request limits).
en.provider_desc_groq: Very fast open models (Llama, Qwen …). Free tier.
en.provider_desc_local: The model runs on your computer on your home network, or on the phone (Termux). Free.
en.provider_desc_mistral: European provider. Free “Experiment” plan with limits.
en.provider_desc_nano: Google's model that's already built into some phones (Pixel 9/10, Galaxy S25 …). Free and offline.
en.provider_desc_on_device: The model (.litertlm) runs right on the phone – offline and free. Needs 1–3 GB of space.
en.provider_desc_openai: GPT models. Pay as you go.
en.provider_desc_openrouter: One key for hundreds of models. Models ending in “:free” are free.
en.provider_key_optional: API key (if the server needs one)
en.provider_model_help: Tap “Load model list” and choose one.
en.provider_no_models_desc: The server didn't return any models.
en.provider_url_help_local: Ollama on a computer: http://COMPUTER-IP:11434/v1 · LM Studio: :1234/v1 · Termux on the phone: http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1
en.providers_guide: Guide: how to add a model
en.providers_intro: The active provider writes the replies. If it fails (error, free quota used up, no internet), the app tries the fallback – e.g. free Gemini or Groq as the main one and an on-device model as the fallback.
en.reason_contact_off: Auto-reply is off for this person.
en.reason_day_limit: Daily limit for this person reached.
en.reason_needs_user: The conversation is waiting for you.
en.reason_not_allowed: This person isn't on the allowed list.
en.region_ad_close_hint: While an ad is open, mark its close button. Only used when an ad is detected and the button is enabled. Without this area it looks for Skip ad / Close ad buttons by their text.
en.region_input_hint: Tap the field where you type a message.
en.region_messages_hint: Tap any message – the whole scrolling list gets selected. Or drag a rectangle from the top to the bottom of the messages.
en.region_name_hint: Tap the person's name at the top of the chat (or circle it with your finger).
en.region_new_chat_hint: Mark the button that starts a chat with a new person. Only used for anonymous chats with new chats turned on. If it's not on this screen, skip the step and mark it later on the right screen.
en.region_send_hint: Tap the send button. If it only appears once there's text in the field (e.g. WhatsApp's microphone), circle its spot.
en.region_status_hint: Circle the spot under your last message where the app shows whether they've seen it (“Seen”, ticks, a small profile picture …). The app learns both looks by itself: right after sending = not seen, just before they reply = seen. You can also capture both states yourself with the 📷 buttons. If you skip this step, it looks for words like “Seen” or “Read” under the last message.
en.retention_note: Chats (with memory and notes) in which nothing happened for longer than this are deleted automatically, once a day.
en.sample_msg_1: Hey! What are you up to this weekend?
en.sample_msg_3: Want to grab coffee on Saturday and maybe go for a walk by the river after? 😊
en.sample_title_german: Chat in German – tests the translator note
en.sample_title_spanish: Chat in Spanish – tests the translator note
en.screen_persona: Who you are and how you write
en.screen_rules: Rules: what it may and may not do
en.service_description: Reads the open chat in a messaging app (the person's name and messages), uses the AI model you chose to write a reply in your style, types it into the field and sends it. Works only in apps and areas you set up yourself, and only when you turn on Auto or tap a button on the panel.
en.session_replaced_text: Your account was signed in on another device (%1$s). Only one device can be signed in at a time – sign in here again to use Messages AI on this phone.
en.setup_auto_found: ✨ Found automatically – check that it's right. Tap Next, or tap the right element to change it.
en.setup_captured: Captured by you (optional): SEEN %1$s · NOT seen %2$s
en.setup_find_none: Couldn't find it automatically – tap it on the screen (or drag a rectangle).
en.setup_learned: Already learned automatically: seen ×%1$d · not seen ×%2$d
en.setup_marked: ✓ Marked – continue or mark it again.
en.setup_move_panel: Move panel to the other edge
en.signin_choice_detail: Use a compatible on-device model, a local server or your own cloud provider key. Review each reply before sending.
en.signin_incomplete: Google sign-in was not completed. Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.
en.signin_local: Your chats stay on your phone
en.signin_local_detail: Chats, memories and settings are stored on your phone. If you choose cloud AI, selected conversation context is sent to that provider. Sign-in uses Firebase.
en.signin_reminder_text: Messages AI doesn't write replies until you open it and sign in.
en.signin_subtitle: Thoughtful replies, with you in control.
en.step_apps: Turn on the apps it should reply in (Apps)
en.step_persona: Describe yourself and how you write
en.svc_ad_stuck: Couldn't close the ad – check it manually.
en.svc_ad_waiting: Ad – waiting for an enabled skip or close button.
en.svc_ai_timeout: The AI didn't answer within %1$d s – trying again later.
en.svc_auto_notifications_only: No chat on the screen and no marked areas: replying from notifications.
en.svc_auto_on_everyone: Auto on – replies to everyone in this app.
en.svc_auto_on_selected: Auto on – replies to the %1$d chosen people.
en.svc_auto_play_note: In this version Auto answers from notifications (Reply button). In an open chat, tap Draft reply.
en.svc_background_limited: ⚠ Without Notification access I reply to closed apps only while the phone is unlocked – turn it on (see the notification).
en.svc_background_on: Also replies when you close the app or lock the phone.
en.svc_background_via_accessibility: This phone doesn't allow notification access – I notice new messages through Accessibility while the phone is unlocked.
en.svc_cannot_type: ⚠ Can't type/send the reply – check the areas with “Test reading”.
en.svc_contact_not_allowed: %1$s isn't on the allowed list (People & chats).
en.svc_contact_not_in_list: %1$s isn't among the people chosen for %2$s – add them in Apps → %2$s → Who it may chat with.
en.svc_day_limit: %1$s already got %2$d messages today – limit reached.
en.svc_field_has_text: There's text in the field: “%1$s”. If it's only the field's hint, tap the button again within 20 s.
en.svc_finding_partner: Looking for a new chat partner …
en.svc_followup_skip: A follow-up doesn't fit – waiting for them.
en.svc_google_ad_waiting: Google ad – waiting until it can be closed.
en.svc_history_caught_up: Read up to what I already knew – %1$d new messages, %2$d remembered with %3$s.
en.svc_home_screen: This is the home screen (%1$s), not a chat – open the conversation in the messaging app first, then tap the button again.
en.svc_hour_limit_stop: Reached %1$d replies in one hour – Auto turned off for safety.
en.svc_last_is_mine: The last message is yours – waiting for %1$s to reply.
en.svc_learn_done: 📚 Done: %1$d chats read, %2$d new messages saved. Already read messages aren't read again.
en.svc_log_copied: Detailed log copied (%1$d lines) – paste it into the chat with the AI. It contains names and message texts from the screen.
en.svc_mark_first: Open a chat first, or mark the areas for this app (“Mark areas”).
en.svc_new_chat_failed: The new chat didn't open – check the marked button.
en.svc_new_chat_limit: Reached the limit of %1$d new chats per hour.
en.svc_new_message_rewrite: A new message arrived in the meantime – writing again.
en.svc_no_app: I can't see an app in the foreground.
en.svc_no_foreground: I can't see an app in the foreground. Open a chat and try again.
en.svc_no_regions: I can't find a chat on the screen in %1$s – open a chat (or mark the areas with “Mark areas”).
en.svc_no_text: No text in the message list – check with “Test reading”.
en.svc_old_on_start: %1$s: the last message is older (%2$s) – I'll reply when they write something new. Tap Draft reply to answer it anyway.
en.svc_other_chat_expected: A different chat is open (%1$s) than expected (%2$s).
en.svc_other_chat_locked: A different chat is open (%1$s) – I only reply to %2$s.
en.svc_panel_hidden: Show the panel again from the Messages AI app.
en.svc_paused_kind: ⏸ %1$s – check the notification and step in.
en.svc_ready_auto_off: Auto was turned off – not sending.
en.svc_ready_loop: The chat keeps changing (%1$s) – pausing for 30 s. Tap Draft reply to answer right away.
en.svc_ready_no_chat: The chat isn't open on the screen any more – not sending.
en.svc_ready_no_field: The text field isn't visible – not sending.
en.svc_ready_other_chat: Another chat is open (%1$s) – not sending.
en.svc_regions_saved: Areas saved for %1$s. Check them with “Test reading”.
en.svc_regions_screens: (Areas are saved for %1$d screens – e.g. the outer and inner screen of a foldable.)
en.svc_resumed: The chat with %1$s was resumed. Waiting for a new message.
en.svc_scrolled_up: The chat is scrolled up and I can't get to the newest messages – scroll down.
en.svc_scrolled_up_waiting: You're reading older messages – I'll reply once you're back at the newest ones or a new message arrives.
en.svc_send_failed: The send button didn't work (the text stayed in the field) – I removed it and will try again. If this repeats, mark the send button with “Mark areas”.
en.svc_user_typing: There's text in the input field (“%1$s”) – not touching it.
en.svc_waiting_for_you: ⏸ %1$s is waiting for you. Resume from the notification or in People & chats.
en.test_auto_regions: ℹ Areas aren't marked – the chat was found automatically. If something is read wrong, mark the areas.
en.test_contact_not_listed: ⚠ %1$s isn't among the people chosen for this app (Apps) – Auto won't write to them.
en.test_input_text: ⚠ There's text in the field: “%1$s” – Auto won't reply until it's empty.
en.test_memory_summary: , has a summary about the person
en.test_moved: ℹ The chat moved (e.g. the keyboard is open) – the areas were found again from the screen.
en.test_ocr: The app hides message text – read from the screen picture (OCR). Messages read: %1$d
en.test_ocr_not_needed: “Always read messages from the screen picture (OCR)” is on, but this app shows the same %1$d messages to Accessibility – I use those (faster, the sender is always right) and check the picture again every few minutes.
en.test_ocr_old_android: No message text found. Reading from the screen picture needs Android 11 or newer.
en.test_scaled: ℹ The areas were set on another screen (foldable, rotation) and are adjusted to this one. For the best result, mark them on this screen too.
en.test_screen_marked: ✓ The areas are set for this screen.
en.test_seen_learning: Still learning: after the next sent message and their reply it will know what “seen” looks like here.
en.test_send_after_typing: Send button: appears once there's text in the field – I'll find it then.
en.test_translator: (you don't speak it – it will mention a translator)
en.test_typing_busy: Typing test: skipped – I'm busy with a reply right now.
en.test_typing_failed: Typing test: ✗ the field didn't take the text (%1$s).
en.test_typing_hidden: Typing test: the app accepted the text (%1$s), but the field doesn't show it to Accessibility – when replying I'll send anyway and remember what worked (%2$s).
en.test_typing_no_field: Typing test: ✗ no text field found.
en.test_typing_no_send: After typing, no button labelled Send was found – I'll try the buttons next to the field. You can also mark it in “Mark areas” (type a letter first so it shows).
en.test_typing_ok: Typing test: ✓ the field takes text (%1$s) – I removed it again.
en.test_typing_skipped: Typing test: skipped – there's already text in the field.
en.test_typing_voice: After typing, the microphone stayed and no Send button appeared – the app didn't notice the text. When replying I'll type again another way (paste, keyboard).
en.test_vision: The app hides message text – the AI read it from the screen picture. Messages read: %1$d
en.test_vision_unavailable: Tip: with a cloud AI that can see pictures (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) the app can also read chats that hide their text.
en.tip_discord: Direct messages. It's best to turn group channels off.
en.tip_google_messages: SMS/RCS. Replying from the notification works. With RCS, “Read” appears under the message.
en.tip_instagram: Direct messages (DMs). “Seen” appears under the message.
en.tip_messenger: Replying from the notification works. “Seen” is a small profile picture under the message – the app learns it by itself.
en.tip_randochat: Anonymous chat with random people: every new chat is a new person (separate history). Turn on “Start the conversation myself” if you want it to write first when a new stranger appears. For automatic matching, mark the “New chat” button on the panel and turn on new chats in this app's settings.
en.tip_samsung_messages: SMS/RCS on Samsung. Replying from the notification works.
en.tip_snapchat: Snapchat notifications often hide the text (“Anna sent you a chat”), so the default mode is “Open the chat and reply on screen”. Messages disappear, so the app keeps them in its own history. For “seen”, mark the status spot under the last message (“Opened”) – the app learns its look by itself.
en.tip_testchat: A fake chat for safe testing (English, Slovenian and German contacts).
en.tip_whatsapp: Notifications include the text and a “Reply” button, so replying from the notification works reliably. For on-screen mode: the send button sits where the microphone is (it appears once there's text in the field). Seen: the blue ticks (described as “Read”) are found automatically.
